findings.description: Argument.get_help_record now always returns a tuple, but when help is None it returns (metavar, None) instead of an empty description string as the docstring and commit title promise. The removed fallback in format_options that substituted "" is gone too.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command has one Argument with help set, so the Positional arguments section is rendered, plus another Argument with no help. The second argument yields (metavar, None). HelpFormatter.write_dl then passes None into text wrapping (wrap_text calls expandtabs on the description), which raises AttributeError, or otherwise renders a bogus row. Impact: --help crashes or misprints for any command that mixes documented and undocumented positional arguments, a common pattern.
